Concepts

This case-sensitive code system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/organization-alias-type defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinitionStatus
legalalternative Legal AlternativeA pseudonym used by an organization to perform their business under a name that differs from the registered, legal name of the business, also known as a trade name, business name, or 'doing business as' (d.b.a.).deprecated
DBA Doing Business AsA DBA, or 'doing business as' is a trade name that allows a business to operate under a name different from its legal name, without creating a separate legal entity.active
Trademark Owned TrademarkThe owner of a trademark is the person who applies the mark to goods that they produce, or uses the mark in the sale or advertising of services that they perform.active
legal Legal Business NameThe official name recorded on government documents, tax filings, and contracts. For a sole proprietor, it's the owner's full legal name.active
historical HistoricalAny previously used legal or trade names used by an organization since the creation of the business. Could include names used by independent organizations before a merger or other reorganization.active
common CommonCommon name, i.e. SNAF, Rehab, etc.active

concept.definition: A pseudonym used by an organization to perform their business under a name that differs from the registered, legal name of the business, also known as a trade name, business name, or 'doing business as' (d.b.a.).
A DBA, or 'doing business as' is a trade name that allows a business to operate under a name different from its legal name, without creating a separate legal entity.
The owner of a trademark is the person who applies the mark to goods that they produce, or uses the mark in the sale or advertising of services that they perform.
The official name recorded on government documents, tax filings, and contracts. For a sole proprietor, it's the owner's full legal name.
Any previously used legal or trade names used by an organization since the creation of the business. Could include names used by independent organizations before a merger or other reorganization.
Common name, i.e. SNAF, Rehab, etc.
